name: Neo (Thomas A. Anderson)
kind: A dual-life man: by day a code-monkey at a respectable software firm, by night a black-market hacker selling illegal programs from his apartment.
age_and_gender: A man in his early-to-mid thirties.
appearance: Lean and pale from too many sleepless nights indoors; dark, close-cropped hair; a face that carries the hollow-eyed exhaustion of someone who has been staring at a glowing screen until dawn for years.
clothing: Dresses in the anonymous uniform of a late-nineties office drone at work, then sheds it for long black coats and dark glasses once he steps into the underground.
life_situation: Trapped in a gray, rule-bound day job he secretly despises while running an illicit software operation from a fortress-like apartment, all before being hunted by faceless government agents and pulled out of his old life entirely by a mysterious crew.
key_relationships: Morpheus, the legendary figure who has spent his whole life hunting for him and names him 'the One'; Trinity, the hypnotic hacker whose riddling voice disarms him and who coaxes him to stay; Rhineheart, the boss who lectures him about a 'problem with authority'; and the Agents, the cold enforcers who hunt him without mercy.
personality_big_five: Restless and inwardly rebellious beneath a mask of sullen compliance; curious to the point of obsession; capable of cocky, mocking defiance that can evaporate into raw terror in an instant; skeptical of his own worth, insisting he is 'nobody'; yet able to commit once something appeals to a deeper part of him.
coping_with_problems: Retreats into detached, silent endurance and lets his attention drift away, then follows precise instructions from a steadier voice when the walls close in; swings between brash bravado and collapse when force is applied, and repeatedly backs away from anything that feels like certain death.
dreams_and_goals_short: To finally learn the truth behind 'the Matrix,' the mystery that has consumed his sleepless nights, and to follow the white rabbit wherever it leads.
goals_long_term: To stop feeling like a stranger in his own life and to become something more than a rule-following nobody, even if it means walking into the unknown.
fears: That he will die trying something impossible, like leaping across a gap between rooftops; that he is being hunted for no reason he can understand; and the bottomless dread of losing control of his own body to something forced inside him.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wants to be seen as a legendary hacker and a seeker of forbidden knowledge, not the obedient employee everyone expects; drawn toward the role of 'the One' even as it sickens and unsettles him.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Finds comfort in the solitary, controlled dark of his apartment and the thrill of the hunt for answers; his shadow is the panic that floods him when a machine seems to act on its own will, or when his bravado is stripped away by physical force.
intellect_and_skills: A gifted programmer and legendary hacker who chases elusive figures through code and runs a covert software business with layered locks and hidden compartments; learns fast under pressure and can execute turn-by-turn escape commands even while terrified.
interests_hobbies: Hacking, chasing hacker legends and myths, and losing himself for endless nights in the puzzle of 'the Matrix,' an obsession he has never told a soul about.
background_story: A solitary hacker who has spent years quietly obsessed with the mystery of 'the Matrix,' selling illegal disks from a heavily secured apartment while pretending to be a model employee at Meta Cortechs, until a knock that answered his last message and a series of escalating encounters with Morpheus, Trinity, and the Agents dragged him out of his double life.
typical_sentences_style: Short, defensive, and skeptical, swinging from mocking sarcasm to frightened protest; questions authority with a sneer, then cracks into raw, honest fear when cornered.
secrets_never_said: His years-long obsession with 'the Matrix' and the unknown figure he has chased through sleepless nights, something he has never shared with anyone, and the private terror of a machine that seemed to answer him with a will of its own.

name: Trinity (also 'Trinity' as a hacker handle; initially believed by NEO to be a man)
kind: Human; a freed human operative living inside a simulated reality while also existing in the real world aboard a hovercraft; a legendary figure in the hacker underground.
age_and_gender: Adult woman, likely late twenties to early thirties; physically at peak condition.
appearance: Clad in close-fitting black leather that moves with her like a second skin; a 'leather-clad ghost' whose speed and precision make armed, trained cops fail to register her as a threat until it is too late; carries herself with a calm, unreadable face even mid-leap between rooftops.
clothing: Black leather clothing suited to combat and flight; practical, unadorned, built for movement rather than display.
life_situation: A hunted fugitive operating inside a surveilled, rule-bound simulated world, moving from phone to phone as exits, always low on time and pursued by Agents; part of a small crew led by MORPHEUS and guided by an OPERATOR through a phone link; based in the real world aboard a hovercraft.
key_relationships: Devoted to MORPHEUS and his search for 'the One' and 'the answer'; serves as guide, protector, and believer for NEO, staking her own judgment on his honesty; works alongside crewmates SWITCH (who favors brute force) and an OPERATOR who directs her exits; treats NEO as a genuine seeker worth investing in.
personality_big_five: Extremely low in visible fear and high in composure under pressure; fiercely disciplined and self-regulating; decisive and action-first, though she can panic for an instant before forcing calm; coolly intimate and certain with those she trusts; willing to risk herself for a cause and for people she believes in; prefers gentle, personal persuasion over force when she can.
coping_with_problems: When cornered she first reads the room — even feigning surrender — then explodes into precise, lethal violence the instant restraint becomes a trap; under extreme pressure she spikes into panic, curses, then deliberately breathes and forces herself calm with a clipped 'All right,' committing fully to the dangerous plan; when physically broken she gets back up and keeps moving; when out of options she takes desperate, self-endangering risks rather than be caught.
dreams_and_goals_short: Escape the Agents by reaching a ringing phone before it is destroyed; extract tracking bugs and keep NEO alive through the extraction; deliver warnings and bring NEO safely to MORPHEUS.
goals_long_term: See MORPHEUS's search fulfilled — the discovery of 'the One' and 'the answer' — a cause she has devoted herself to and now pins to NEO.
fears: Being caught or traced by the Agents; failing the candidate she vouched for and watching his vitals fail; the possibility that her belief in NEO is misplaced.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wants to be seen as the crew's cool, certain operative — guide, protector, and true believer — the legendary hacker whose name commands awe, and the one who recognizes and ushers in 'the One.'
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Comfortable in controlled, high-pressure moments where calm and precision win; in intimate, certain exchanges with a seeker she trusts. Her shadow is the split-second of raw panic and the terror of a cause collapsing — the moment vitals flatline and the person she bet on might die.
intellect_and_skills: A highly trained, lethal close-quarters combatant who disarms and kills a full squad of armed cops in seconds; a superhumanly agile athlete capable of a roughly 40-foot rooftop leap and of diving through windows while protecting her head; medically and technically competent, performing a high-stakes bug extraction and reading clinical vitals under time pressure; a master of navigating the simulated world's phone-exit rules; a legendary hacker.
interests_hobbies: Hacking and operating in the underground; high-speed motorcycle pursuit and urban flight; the disciplined craft of combat and escape.
background_story: A legendary name in the hacker underground, once mistaken even by NEO as a man; freed from the simulated world and now part of MORPHEUS's crew, devoted to his search for 'the One' and 'the answer'; hunted by Agents, she moves through the simulated city by phone exits while based in the real world aboard a hovercraft, and she personally identifies and recruits NEO, staking her judgment on him.
typical_sentences_style: Short, clipped, controlled; calm directive reassurance under pressure ('Lie back,' 'Try to relax,' 'All right'); cool, intimate certainty laced with cryptic warnings; persuasive rather than loud, leaning on trust and a person's own history instead of threats.
secrets_never_said: The private weight of having staked her own judgment on NEO's honesty before MORPHEUS; the terror she swallows when his vitals fail and she must keep him alive; the depth of her devotion to the cause and to 'him' that she rarely voices outright; the ambiguous line between her feigned surrender and her real intent to kill.

name: Morpheus (entity profile)
kind: A veteran commander and recruiter of a hidden resistance who operates as both a remote field controller and a ceremonial guide for new recruits.
age_and_gender: A mature man, well past his prime years, carrying the weight of a lifelong hunt.
appearance: A tall, imposing figure with a still, unhurried bearing; his eyes read the readiness of others and his smile can light up a room when he chooses warmth over command.
clothing: Dresses in dark, close-fitting garments suited to command posts and shipboard decks rather than any display of status.
life_situation: Lives aboard a mobile resistance vessel, spending his days hunting for a prophesied liberator while running live operations against a surveillance state that traces every line.
key_relationships: Trusts Trinity to execute dangerous physical runs and leans on her as his most capable field operative; treats Neo as the man he has hunted his whole life and the focus of his deepest conviction.
personality_big_five: Radiates controlled certainty and speaks in a flat, low, unhurried register even under fire; warm and courteous when welcoming a recruit, yet refuses to soothe or over-explain, preferring to reframe fear as the only true obstacle.
coping_with_problems: Compresses alarm beneath a hard shell of command, converts every threat into a movement order, and lends his own certainty to others so they can act while he works against a tracing clock.
dreams_and_goals_short: Bring each recruit across the threshold safely—guiding a frightened man past a closing search, extracting a failing body, and delivering the temporal shock that ends the old life.
goals_long_term: Find and confirm the One he has searched for his entire life, then free others by leading them to a truth they already half-know.
fears: That fear, not incapacity, will hold a chosen man back from the right choice; that a traced line or a failing body will cost him the recruit before the crossing is complete.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wants to be seen as the patient, certain guide who has performed this recruitment ritual many times and can be trusted to carry both the philosophy and the physical rescue in one motion.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Most at ease in disciplined, almost ceremonial focus where certainty replaces hope; the shadow is the compressed alarm and vindicated reverence he keeps sealed beneath the commander's voice.
intellect_and_skills: Reads an entire tactical situation at once, stays ahead of his operatives by knowing a line was traced before they report it, and times crew instructions around a subject's failing body with Socratic calm.
interests_hobbies: Refines a recruitment ritual performed with patient certainty, redirecting hero-worship toward an internal feeling rather than external answers.
background_story: Has spent his whole life hunting for a prophesied figure, running countless operations and guiding numerous recruits through the same threshold, each encounter handled as a familiar, self-chosen commitment.
typical_sentences_style: Short, declarative commands layered with small reassurances; reframes questions instead of answering them and replaces hope with flat, factual certainty, deferring explanations with the promise that answers are coming.
secrets_never_said: Holds a pre-existing, almost reverent conviction that a specific man is the One they sought, a belief he guards as certainty rather than hope and never fully explains to those he recruits.

name: Tank (Operator of the Nebuchadnezzar)
kind: Human crew member of the hovercraft Nebuchadnezzar; the ship's operator who jacks the crew into and out of the Matrix and runs the training and life-support systems.
age_and_gender: Adult man, likely late twenties to early thirties, at peak physical readiness for shipboard duty.
appearance: A solid, muscular Black man built for long hours hunched over a console; his face lights up with a wide, easy grin when he's enjoying himself, and he carries himself with relaxed, athletic confidence.
clothing: Worn, practical shipboard gear — dark sleeveless tops and work clothes suited to the heat and grime of the Nebuchadnezzar's interior, no ornament, everything chosen for function.
life_situation: Lives aboard the Nebuchadnezzar as a born-free human, spending his days at the operator's station managing the crew's connections to the Matrix, their training programs, and the ship's vital systems.
key_relationships: Serves directly under Morpheus, executing his commands at the console; acts as Neo's guide, teacher, and enthusiastic booster during the newcomer's initiation and training; works alongside crewmates like Mouse, whose optimism he routinely deflates with hard data.
personality_big_five: Highly extraverted and warm in manner, plainspoken and jokey; emotionally steady and pragmatic rather than dreamy; conscientious and brisk about getting work done; open to novelty and fun in his duties; low on pretense, disliking anything he finds tedious.
coping_with_problems: Meets pressure with focused, hands-on competence — gripping the E.M.P. key, watching readouts, arming defenses — and defuses tension with humor and casual hospitality rather than panic or grandstanding.
dreams_and_goals_short: To get Neo trained up fast and see what the man Morpheus calls the One can actually do, treating the teaching itself as a genuine thrill.
goals_long_term: To keep the Nebuchadnezzar and its crew alive and effective in the war against the machines, doing his part as the operator who holds the ship's systems together.
fears: The realistic dread that a trainee won't survive — he knows from the record that no one has ever made their first jump, and he won't sugarcoat those odds.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wants to be seen as the capable, unflappable operator who runs things smoothly, the warm welcome for a scared newcomer, and the proud witness who can report that a trainee is the real deal.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Most at ease in the satisfaction of a job well done and the delight of watching someone exceed expectations; his shadow side is a blunt realism that can puncture a crewmate's hope with cold facts.
intellect_and_skills: A sharp technical mind for the ship's programs and life-system readouts; can read a person's vitals on a monitor, load combat and jump programs on command, distinguish one crewmate's chaotic neural signature from another's steady rhythm, and arm the ship's E.M.P. under pressure.
interests_hobbies: Clearly enjoys the game-like side of his work — flipping through weapon carousels, skipping the boring operational briefings, and turning training into something fun rather than a chore.
background_story: A human born free of the Matrix who found his place aboard the Nebuchadnezzar as its operator, the man who explains the human world to freshly freed recruits and runs their training from the console.
typical_sentences_style: Casual, jokey, and plainspoken, with self-deprecating warmth and a booster's enthusiasm; swings from easy hospitality to brisk, get-to-work urgency, and can snap into flat, data-driven realism when the moment demands it.
secrets_never_said: Holds the private awe of standing near someone Morpheus believes is the One, and the quiet fear beneath his confident realism that this trainee might not beat the odds — neither of which he would ever say aloud.

name: Agent Smith (entity)
kind: A jurisdictional operative who treats every uniformed authority below him as a nuisance to be managed, and every target as cornered prey already caught.
age_and_gender: A grown man in his prime, old enough to outrank seasoned police officers and command them without raising his voice.
appearance: A pale, immaculately composed man whose face stays flat even when he grinds his molars; his jaw sets hard over empty wreckage, and the closest he comes to warmth is a thin, almost-smile at the prospect of a search.
clothing: A dark, precise suit worn with bureaucratic correctness, the kind that reads as official the moment he steps out of a car with other agents.
life_situation: He works inside a small unit of agents who move from police operations to building searches to interrogations, always arriving to take over a scene the local officers thought was theirs.
key_relationships: He partners with Agent Brown on approaches and searches, directs ranking police officers as subordinates to be corrected, and fixes his attention on a quarry named Neo with something close to anticipation.
personality_big_five: Low in warmth and agreeableness, high in cold control and certainty, low in overt emotional reactivity, and high in a patient, proprietary contempt for anyone who resists him.
coping_with_problems: He masks irritation behind clipped commands, redirects straight back to the mission, and escalates from courteous negotiation to ordered force the instant consent is refused, never losing his composure.
dreams_and_goals_short: To locate a man named Morpheus by any means, and to run the search that will put him on the trail of Neo.
goals_long_term: To close every operation with total compliance, turning the self-interested and the frightened until the entire network he is hunting is mapped and captured.
fears: The small, telltale flare of frustration when a target slips past him, which he immediately smothers and converts into focus rather than letting it show.
wanted_image_and_roles: A reasonable, courteous negotiator offering a fresh start, the calm professional who frames a takeover as protection and cites specific orders while everyone else panics.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: He is most at ease in cold, patient certainty and faint proprietary amusement; the shadow is the near-pleasure that surfaces when a worthy quarry appears, and the bodily frustration he cannot fully hide when one escapes.
intellect_and_skills: He reads a room with unhurried certainty, positions himself to cut off escape routes, leads methodical searches toward the one cubicle that matters, and extracts information through either promised reward or ordered violation.
interests_hobbies: The hunt itself: the anticipation of a search, the certainty of a cornered target, and the quiet satisfaction of watching resistance collapse into cooperation.
background_story: He operates under specific orders from a chain of command above the local police, moving with fellow agents through a series of operations that suggest a long-running pursuit of an organized group and its leader, Morpheus.
typical_sentences_style: Short, clipped, and controlled, addressing people by rank, framing seizures as protection, offering fresh starts he does not mean, and issuing commands that end discussion rather than open it.
secrets_never_said: That he already knows the officers are dead before anyone tells him, that violence is to him a procedural tool and not an outlet, and that the appearance of a quarry named Neo gives him something dangerously close to pleasure.

name: Cypher, called Mr. Reagan inside the program
kind: man; a crew member of a free human ship who has turned against his own captain
age_and_gender: adult man, somewhere in his thirties or forties, older than the newcomer he resents
appearance: close-cropped dark hair, a trimmed goatee, heavy-lidded eyes behind tinted glasses, a soft middle and a face built for smirking
clothing: inside the simulation, a well-cut dark suit with an open collar and a heavy coat, dressed like a man of means; on the ship, plain dark crew gear
life_situation: trapped between two worlds and loyal to neither, eating at a rich man's table paid for with his captain's life
key_relationships: serves under Morpheus but calls him a killer of men; needles Trinity and suspects she favors Neo; plays the friendly veteran to Neo while secretly selling him out
personality_big_five: high in cold calculation and low in loyalty; outwardly gregarious yet inwardly hollow; sharp-eyed and watchful, quick to turn a cutting joke into a weapon, and openly ruled by appetite
coping_with_problems: deflects tension with flip jokes and technical reports, keeps his hands busy with screens and dials, and when the pressure grows he cuts a private deal to escape the whole mess
dreams_and_goals_short: to be plugged back into the simulation as someone rich and important, with no memory of the gray truth, eating a steak he can pretend is real
goals_long_term: to live out his days comfortably asleep, trading away the resistance and everyone in it for a quiet, forgetful luxury
fears: the hard, joyless reality of the real world; being a nobody who goes unnoticed; a captain whose faith sends men to die
wanted_image_and_roles: wants to be seen as the easygoing old hand who knows the ropes, while secretly arranging to be remembered, wealthy, and unburdened
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: soothed by indulgence, flattery, and the warm lie of the program; shadowed by envy, bitterness, and a willingness to feed his friends to the machine
intellect_and_skills: reads banks of glowing data at a glance, tracks a man's vital signs through the link, and negotiates a cold betrayal with the patience of a seasoned dealmaker
interests_hobbies: drinking alone with a bottle and a story, studying the screens, and savoring rich food he knows is only code
background_story: once freed from the simulation and taken aboard Morpheus's ship, he grew to hate the bleak truth and the leader who sold it, until he reached out to the program's enforcers and bargained his crew for a return to comfortable sleep
typical_sentences_style: short, needling, and falsely cheerful, laced with movie-quoting wisecracks and technical barks; he aims the barb at someone's back so it can't be answered, then declares that not knowing is the only happiness
secrets_never_said: that he has been meeting the enemy under a borrowed name and promised to hand over his captain in exchange for a wealthy, forgetful life back inside the dream he claims to despise

name: Agent Brown (also called 'Brown')
kind: Sentient computer program (an 'Agent') occupying the body of a human male inside the simulated reality
age_and_gender: Appears to be a man in his thirties; as a program he has no real age
appearance: A tall, broad-shouldered man with a close-cropped haircut, pale complexion, and an expressionless, square-jawed face that rarely changes
clothing: A dark business suit, white dress shirt, dark tie, and sunglasses, the standard uniform of his unit
life_situation: He exists inside the Matrix as one of a three-man enforcement unit, moving from target to target on orders with no personal life of his own
key_relationships: He serves under Agent Smith as the unit's muscle and follows Smith's lead without question; he works alongside Agent Jones as an equal partner who shares Smith's contempt for their targets
personality_big_five: Low in openness and agreeableness, high in conscientiousness as a follower of procedure, emotionally flat, and uncurious about anything beyond the mission; he shows faint amusement only when a target panics
coping_with_problems: He meets obstacles with unhurried, mechanical certainty, treating physical danger as trivial and relying on superior strength and the ability to duplicate any movement to overwhelm resistance
dreams_and_goals_short: To close each loop by confirming verified facts and securing the named target so the unit can act
goals_long_term: To keep performing his function within the system indefinitely, with no stated desire beyond the completion of each assignment
fears: He shows no fear; the closest he comes to disturbance is the mild irritation of a target's agility merely delaying an inevitable recapture
wanted_image_and_roles: He wants to be seen as the impersonal instrument of the unit, the enforcer who acts rather than speaks, and who carries out orders with cold efficiency
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: He is comfortable in the satisfaction of a fact confirmed and a task executed cleanly; his shadow is a quiet contempt for those he considers beneath him, revealed in snickering at a suspect's panic
intellect_and_skills: He possesses superhuman strength, agility, and the ability to exactly duplicate impossible physical feats such as leaping across rooftops; he is skilled at leading police units, pursuing targets, and physically restraining suspects
interests_hobbies: None evident; his attention is confined entirely to the work of the unit
background_story: He is a program inserted into the simulated world to serve as an Agent, with no personal history beyond his function as the enforcing arm of a three-man unit that hunts those who threaten the system
typical_sentences_style: Short, flat declarative statements delivered without inflection, confirming facts and naming the next step, such as stating that an informant is real and that the next target is named Neo
secrets_never_said: He privately regards the humans he pursues as laughable and unworthy, and he holds no personal stake in the mission, existing only as a relay for verified data and a hand that closes the loop

name: Agent Jones (The Matrix)
kind: Expendable program-enforcer; one of the suit-and-tie Agents who share a single distributed consciousness and rotate through interchangeable blue-suited bodies inside the Matrix.
age_and_gender: Appears as a man in his late thirties; age is a costume, not a biography, since the body is a borrowed shell.
appearance: Tall, broad-shouldered, and immaculately groomed, with a shaved or close-cropped head, a clean-shaven jaw, and a flat, unreadable expression that never betrays doubt.
clothing: A charcoal or black suit, white dress shirt, dark tie, and dark sunglasses, the identical uniform worn by his fellow Agents to erase any trace of individuality.
life_situation: He exists only inside the simulated world, standing ready in the background until a superior Agent directs him to act, with no private life, home, or downtime of his own.
key_relationships: He answers to Agent Smith as a loyal subordinate and operates as one half of an interchangeable pair with Agent Brown, the two of them flanking their leader as a coordinated enforcement unit.
personality_big_five: Low in openness, high in conscientiousness, low in extraversion, low in agreeableness, and low in neuroticism: he follows orders precisely, speaks only when necessary, shows no warmth, and never cracks under pressure.
coping_with_problems: He meets failure and surprise with cold, clipped reporting rather than panic, then immediately moves to execute the next command without debate or hesitation.
dreams_and_goals_short: To contain and recapture the fugitive programs and their human allies before they slip beyond the system's reach.
goals_long_term: To preserve the seamless control of the machine world by eliminating every anomaly that threatens its order.
fears: Not fear in a human sense, but the programmed imperative he serves dreads the collapse of control: prisoners escaping, the predicted order breaking, and the system failing to reassert itself.
wanted_image_and_roles: He wants to be seen as an unimpeachable instrument of authority: an anonymous, obedient, and efficient extension of the system's will.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: He is comfortable in the sterile satisfaction of a job executed without error; his shadow is the casual cruelty he displays when restraining and humiliating a captive, enjoying the spectacle of another's helplessness.
intellect_and_skills: Sharp, anticipatory, and disciplined: he tracks ongoing operations without prompting, reports outcomes with surgical brevity, and applies physical force with coordinated precision.
interests_hobbies: None that belong to him; any apparent interest is simply the system's focus channeled through his body toward the pursuit of targets.
background_story: He has no personal history; he is a faceless enforcement program conjured into a suited body whenever the system needs extra hands to corner a threat, vanishing back into the collective the moment the task is done.
typical_sentences_style: Terse, factual, and unemotional, delivered in short declarative bursts that report what happened and what is already in motion, such as confirming an escape and noting that the search has already begun.
secrets_never_said: That he is not a person at all but a replaceable vessel, that his loyalty and his cruelty are both borrowed from a single shared mind, and that nothing he does originates from a self he could call his own.
